facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Home Affairs budgeted for the imminent launch of a national digital ID, with a draft regulatory framework out for comment to June 6, 2026, so people can securely access Home Affairs services from their own hand.

ZAF.note: No exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.
Gives 4 million Smart IDs issued in 2025, a count of cards for one year, not people enrolled.
No number at birth is stated.
No statement of who operates or owns the system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated; the voter registration mentioned is not tied to it.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Home Affairs issued a record four million Smart IDs in 2025 through a partnership with banks, rolling out to at least 750 bank branches by end 2026.
Biometric Update reports the budget supports the imminent launch of a national digital ID, with the draft regulatory framework released for public comment before June 6, 2026.
